test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them contains a spelling error. Select the option that rectifies the error.**

Heritage helps us understand our past, apreciate our present and shape our future.
solution:
The correct answer is "**appreciate**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence contains a spelling error in the word "**apreciate**".
 
• The correct spelling of this word is "**appreciate**".
 
• So, sentence with all the correct words is-
 
 
• **"Heritage helps us understand our past, appreciate our present and shape our future.**

 
 
 

Thus, ***option 1*** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Appreciate: **recognize the full worth of.
 
• **Heritage: **property that is or may be inherited; an inheritance.
 
• **Present: **in a particular place.
 
• **Understand**: perceive the intended meaning of (words, a language, or a speaker).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• Appreciate: के पूरे मूल्य को पहचानें।
 
• Heritage: संपत्ति जो विरासत में मिली है या हो सकती है; एक विरासत।
 
• Present: किसी विशेष स्थान पर।
 
• Understand: (शब्द, एक भाषा, या एक वक्ता) के अभीष्ट अर्थ को समझें।
